text:
maria: quick follow-up from the postmortem — Friday's outage exposed two recurring vendor/dependency gaps: cloud auth token churn + model-registry 503s. We need owners, deadlines, and a small runbook for immediate ops. Can we triage ownership here?

joel: I'll take cloud auth TTL/retry policy. Plan: add jitter to backoff, cap retries, and request an SLA exception/review with the provider. ETA 2026-04-08 for the change + canary. I'll also file the provider ticket.

sam: I'll own model-registry fallback (local manifest cache + serve-from-cache when upstream 5xx). I'll open a PR today and wire a feature flag. ETA 2026-04-05.

anya: please add explicit action items and link to the postmortem doc in the tracker. We also need an automated alert: auth 5xx rate > 0.5% over 5m so oncall gets paged before cascade.

liz: I'll coordinate customer comms for tenants impacted by degraded reads. Drafting a short note, want to sync before we send.

deploy-bot: branch 'registry-cache-fallback' created by sam — CI queued.

maria: summary (I'll own the tracker):
1) cloud auth retry/jitter + canary — joel — due 2026-04-08
2) provider SLA review + account escalation — joel — due 2026-04-15
3) model-registry cache + fallback PR + staging test — sam — due 2026-04-05
4) ops runbook for fallback + quick-restart steps — anya — due 2026-04-03
5) customer communication draft — liz — due 2026-04-06
Also: add weekly auth error digest and postmortem follow-up review in #eng-sre.

sam: runbook snippet to include in the PR (quick example):
```
# check auth error rate
curl -s 'https://metrics.api.local/query?query=auth_errors_rate_5m'
# quick recovery: restart auth-proxy on nodes with high errors
kubectl rollout restart deploy/auth-proxy -n infra --timeout=5m
```

anya: I'll add a Grafana alert rule and a dashboard panel for auth_errors_rate_5m. Proposed alert: if >0.005 (0.5%) for 5m -> page oncall and create a ticket. I'll also own the first runbook draft and schedule the checklist review for next Tue.

maria: OK, next check-in is Friday EOD in this thread. I'll ping owners daily until those due dates. I'll also add an item to the recurring-incidents board to track if this pattern reappears (auth churn / registry 5xx). Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

liz: ack, will share draft by tomorrow noon.

joel: filing vendor ticket + pinging account team now. will post ticket link here.

deploy-bot: CI passed for registry-cache-fallback (sam) — staging deploy scheduled.
